unit: RK-UI-001 and RK-HANDOFF-001 two-axis notice, calculator normal reset, and post-reset stale-state rejection

semanticOwners.twoAxisIntent: packages/schema rankingSelectionSchema and ranking executionIntent union

canonicalFlow: selected RankingPolicyDetail carries selfBuffs and conditionalEffects in current schema
handoff constructs ranking PortableCalculationRequest and replays it through the shared application executor
CalculationContextNotice renders start NP, self-buff policy, conditional-effects policy, and version metadata

explicit normal reset validates the retained request subject, keeps scenario and versionContext unchanged, changes only execution intent to calculator/10000/standard, executes before publish, and commits request/result/fingerprint together
successful reset replaces only the request intent and result identity; scenario facts, ordered actions/choice, inputs, and stochastic facts remain intact
reset failure leaves the retained durable and in-memory pair unchanged and reports a typed reason
mutation token prevents an older asynchronous draft/reset publication from replacing a newer calculator state

preserved: retained request scenario byte-for-byte, including target/field facts, canonical inputs, stochastic facts, ordered actions/choice, effect decisions, and candidate evidence
retained request servant identity and the matching current build subject
removed: ranking execution intent and both policy axes
resetDisposition.baseline: calculator intent with initialNpGauge 10000 and standard calculator policy, retained scenario/version context, and a newly computed portable fingerprint
resetDisposition.failure: typed rejection or durable-write failure retains the old request/result/fingerprint

staleRejection.ranking: worker instance, context ID, request ID, fingerprint, and detail entry ID gates remain unchanged
staleRejection.reset: one App-owned mutation gate covers scenario edit, reset, current-history copy, historical regeneration, version upgrade, ranking handoff, and finalizer publication; older tokens cannot publish workspace state or reset error after a newer mutation begins
staleRejection.cache: RK-CACHE-001 contract is reused: worker summary maximum 1, worker detail 0, React active detail maximum 1

stateByPath.forward: retained scenario and version context are executed with calculator intent, then request/result/fingerprint/draft are durably replaced before workspace/session/route publication
stateByPath.failureRetention: subject resolution, execution, fingerprint, or durable-write failure leaves the prior request/result/fingerprint/draft and exposes a typed recovery reason
stateByPath.recovery: version upgrade, invalid reset, and failed durable publication retain the prior usable state until an explicit valid operation commits
stateByPath.alternateWriters: App navigation, undo, profile import, version upgrade, ranking handoff, finalizer, and all history paths use the same App-owned mutation gate and commitPortableDraft owner

parity.calculatorRankingPortable: existing ranking worker detail parity and portableCalculation reconstruction tests remain valid; E2E compares selected ranking average with calculator result
parity.fingerprint: ranking and calculator identities remain distinct; reset produces a new calculator request fingerprint

playwright.command: pnpm test:e2e -- e2e/ranking-baseline.spec.ts --grep 'E2E-050' and pnpm test:e2e -- e2e/initial-oc.spec.ts --grep 'E2E-051'
playwright.coverage: real ranking worker, two-axis notice, calculator result parity, normal reset, failed reset retention, reload, keyboard reset, 390px/320px overflow

lint.command: pnpm exec eslint <changed source and unit test files> --max-warnings=0

format.command: pnpm exec prettier --check <changed source, test, and E2E files>

reusedEvidence.tsk06_41: current schema direct writer, ranking-to-calculator replay, typed contribution compilation, and portable parity
reusedEvidence.tsk06_5: candidate inventory, support status, production output, calculator/ranking/portable parity, and legacy removal
reusedEvidence.rkCache001: summary/detail cache cardinality and request/context/fingerprint stale rejection

stopCondition: TSK-07 is closed when the integrated quality artifact, focused reset/intent fixture, four stale-publication order cases, and document consistency are recorded; reopen TSK-06.41 or TSK-06.5 only if canonical fingerprint, support status, candidate inventory, production output, or parity changes.
